messages:
Tanya: Hey everyone — quick heads up: Reece's birthday is next Thu, May 12. Thinking low-key hybrid celebration during the 10am PT standup window. Options: 1) Office cake 2) Doughnuts 3) Individual snack boxes 4) No food, just a meme e-card chain. Vote with the number or emoji! :tada:
Reece: lol appreciate this — totally low key is fine. if folks want snacks that's sweet. 10am PT works for me. thanks! :blush:
Maya: 10am PT is 1am my time :sweat_smile: can we confirm a slightly later time or record? i'll send a gif if i can't make it.
Zoe: I can bring a cake to SF office if we pick cake. what flavors do people like? chocolate or lemon? :cake:
Tanya: noted — maybe set poll after votes. Reece, would you prefer we do the Zoom at 11am PT to help APAC?
Reece: 11am PT would be great — less jetlag for Maya. thanks for thinking about timezones!
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Birthday reminder for Reece on 2026-05-12 11:00 PT. RSVP link: https://company.zoom/meet/reece-bday (auto-post)
Maya: thanks bot :raised_hands: i'll drop a silly meme in the e-card thread earlier that day.
Zoe: cake + meme card sounds perfect. vote: 1 :one: for cake.
Tanya: i'll do a quick emoji tally: :one: for cake, :two: for doughnuts, :three: for snack boxes, :four: for no-food. react here pls.
Reece: also if anyone wants to send a physical gift, pls DM Tanya for the address — otherwise meme card and virtual high-fives totally fine. :heart:
Maya: sending a ridiculous dinosaur GIF to start the meme chain now. :joy:
Tanya: Great — cake is winning so far. I'll order for SF office and set up the Zoom for 11am PT. posting calendar invite shortly. :calendar:
